criteria.text: Record parent-sync retry keeps exact pathname/inode and creates no duplicate.
Guard file/parent sync failure propagates and retries same guard.
Verified Debian 8 runlevel-2 activation loads exactly once per boot.
Loaded/absent-module remove and purge delete generated records and restore baseline safely.
One canonical Architecture armhf DEB and two byte-identical module/DEB builds pass static gates.
Disposable image install/test/remove restores exactly under continuous lock; failure quarantines.
Real hardware manual/reload and one bounded reboot prove automatic delta exactly +1 without anomaly.
Target cleanup/purge restores identity, paths, records, activation, hashes, taint, connectivity.
